fields.reasoning: Confirmed the finding against the code: watchdog_policy.go sets DefaultCommandLimit to 30m and StallLimit returns it for a command step with no stall of its own, while ship rebase runs the local gate (make gate, up to an hour) on the merged head before pushing. Without a stall the watchdog would stop and retry the rebase partway through the gate. The repo's own convention (ship-change-classic.toml and docs.toml comments, the builtin gate step) is stall = "70m" on every step that runs the gate, so following it is the least surprising answer and needs no new mechanism; the acceptance must check it so the defect cannot ship.
fields.statement: The new rebase step that runs rhiza ship rebase sets stall = "70m" (at least the gate step's stall), like every other step that runs ship rebase or ship gate. The leaf ship-steps-rebase-clean's acceptance requires that stall on the step, and its failure case fails when the stall is missing or below the gate's.
